result.description: All-in-one collaborative doc platform (now branded Superhuman Docs) combining documents, tables, automations and apps.
result.auth_detail: REST API v1: per-user API token sent as Authorization Bearer header (no OAuth for REST API). The official hosted MCP server uses OAuth 2 (or an MCP-restricted personal access token), per a secondary source.
result.access_detail: API is free for all users in free and paid workspaces. Creating docs requires Doc Maker/Admin role. Rate limits apply (e.g. 100 reads/6s, 10 writes/6s). MCP free-plan quota reportedly limited (unverified).
result.api_notes: REST v1 at https://coda.io/apis/v1 with OpenAPI spec. Groups: Folders, Docs (CRUD, permissions, publishing), Pages (incl. content export), Tables, Columns, Rows (list/upsert/update/delete, push button), Formulas and Controls (read only), Automations (trigger only), Account, Analytics, mutation status. Writes are async (202 + requestId). Docs moved to docs.superhuman.com after rebrand.

evidence.quote: The API token is invalid or has expired.
We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
This API uses a base path of `https://coda.io/apis/v1`.
If you plan to integrate Superhuman Docs with an AI tool, you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server.
Under the hood, Superhuman Docs runs an MCP server built on the open Model Context Protocol standard, giving AI clients tools to work directly in your docs.
